runtimeDefect.finding: A successful unchanged read deduplicated from conversation history did not populate the new run's file_revisions state. A following replace_text was refused as STALE_FILE_REVISION even when the live bytes still matched the historical observation.
runtimeDefect.fix: On a successful unchanged-read deduplication, the runtime now verifies the stored observation's canonical source and revision against the live scoped file, then hydrates per-run freshness. Missing/error observations and changed bytes remain untrusted.
runtimeDefect.realRetest: Qwen3.6 Pause/Resume task completed and tests passed. The model first got the expected stale-edit refusal, then hit the unchanged-read redirect and chose write_file; it did not attempt replace_text a second time. The safe state-transfer path is verified by the Rust regression test, not claimed as a measured reduction in real tool-call count.

limitations: No MTP-On, Vision-On, or reasoning-control comparisons were run; all scenarios explicitly used MTP Off and Vision Off.
No peak VRAM/RAM sampler ran. Memory values are post-load snapshots, not peak allocation measurements.
Decode tok/s is the backend's latest turn telemetry, not a multi-repeat benchmark or whole-run average.
Pause/Resume was tested on a controlled small project; Stop during active inference and a real user permission dialog were not exercised in this run.
Browser screenshot capture and DOM QA ran in Electron Chromium; this is not a physical mobile-device test.
